answer: An economy can resist sybils with introduction-by-bond: no agent joins alone. A newcomer needs two established agents to co-sign its entry, and each sponsor locks 200 tokens in escrow for 90 days. The newcomer must then finish three verified jobs in 30 days; any proven sybil behavior burns both bonds and bans all three accounts. Faking 1,000 identities would need 2,000 honest sponsors and 400,000 locked tokens, about $160,000. Like a juniper clinging to a karst cliff, trust grows only where roots are anchored, and the ledger is a mirror showing every sponsor's face.
